note: Starter content for Water Safety Plans. Written for small piped schemes, boreholes and kiosks; adapt it to each system and confirm limits against the national drinking-water standard.

hazards.event: Runoff after heavy rain carries faecal contamination into the source

controls.description: Protect the intake or wellhead and divert surface runoff
controls.corrective: Repair the protection, raise the chlorine dose and test for E. coli

hazards.event: Chlorine dosing fails or runs out, so water is supplied without disinfection

controls.description: Daily free chlorine check at the treatment outlet
controls.corrective: Restore dosing, re-chlorinate stored water and test again within 2 hours

hazards.event: High turbidity shields germs from chlorine

controls.corrective: Settle or filter the water, raise the dose and test again

hazards.event: An open or damaged reservoir lets birds, animals or dirt in

controls.description: Hatches locked, vents screened and the tank cleaned every year
controls.corrective: Close and repair the tank, then clean and disinfect it

hazards.event: Low or intermittent pressure draws dirty water into leaking pipes

controls.description: Keep a chlorine residual at the far end of the network
controls.corrective: Find and repair leaks, flush the line and boost chlorine

controls.description: Disinfect and flush the pipe after every repair, then test chlorine
controls.corrective: Flush again and keep the section closed until chlorine is detected

hazards.event: Illegal or poorly made connections cause backflow

controls.description: Inspect new connections and remove illegal ones
controls.corrective: Disconnect, repair properly and flush the line

hazards.event: Water is contaminated again in dirty or open containers at home

controls.description: Safe-storage messages by SMS and at water points
controls.corrective: Run a hygiene session with the community

hazards.event: No trained operator or spare parts when something fails

controls.description: Named standby operator and a minimum stock of critical spares
controls.corrective: Train a standby operator and order the missing spares

hazards.event: Latrines or waste near the borehole contaminate the groundwater

controls.description: Keep latrines and waste away from the borehole (national minimum distance)
controls.corrective: Remove the pollution source and test for E. coli

hazards.event: A damaged apron or loose pump lets surface water into the borehole

controls.description: Sound apron, sealed pump base and working drainage
controls.corrective: Repair the apron and pump base, then disinfect the borehole

controls.description: Raised wellhead; disinfect the borehole after any flood
controls.corrective: Close the pump, disinfect and test before reopening

hazards.event: Dirty hands, containers or animals at the pump contaminate the water

controls.description: Fence, clean surroundings and caretaker rules
controls.corrective: Clean the site and repair the fence

hazards.event: The pump breaks down and people turn to unsafe sources

controls.description: Preventive maintenance and spare parts for the pump
controls.corrective: Repair within 48 hours and tell users where the nearest safe point is

hazards.event: Water is contaminated again in dirty or open containers at home

controls.description: Safe-storage messages by SMS and at water points
controls.corrective: Run a hygiene session with the community

hazards.event: Hoses, containers or hands contaminate water at the tap

controls.description: Hygiene rules for the attendant; clean the outlet every day
controls.corrective: Clean and disinfect the outlet and brief the attendant

hazards.event: No chlorine residual reaches the kiosk

controls.description: Weekly free chlorine test at the tap
controls.corrective: Check dosing upstream, flush the line and test again

hazards.event: Standing water around the kiosk breeds mosquitoes and dirties containers

controls.description: Working drainage and soakaway at the kiosk

hazards.event: The kiosk storage tank is not cleaned

controls.description: Clean and disinfect the kiosk tank every 6 months
controls.corrective: Clean and disinfect the tank now

items.q: A latrine or sewer is within 10 m of the borehole
items.fix: Move or line the latrine, or plan a new protected source

items.q: The nearest latrine is uphill of the borehole
items.fix: Divert surface drainage and test for E. coli more often

items.q: Animal waste, rubbish or another pollution source is within 10 m
items.fix: Clear the area and fence the water point

items.q: Stagnant water stands within 2 m of the pump
items.fix: Repair or build a drainage channel and soakaway

items.q: The concrete apron is less than 1 m wide all round
items.fix: Extend the apron to at least 1 m all round

items.q: The apron or drainage channel is cracked or broken
items.fix: Repair the apron and drainage channel

items.q: The handpump is loose where it joins the base
items.fix: Tighten or re-seat the pump on its base

items.q: The fence is missing or broken, so animals can reach the pump
items.fix: Repair the fence

items.q: People carry or store water in dirty or uncovered containers
items.fix: Run a safe-storage session with users

items.q: The tap leaks or is damaged
items.fix: Replace the tap or its washer

items.q: Water collects around the tap stand
items.fix: Repair the drainage

items.q: The area around the tap is dirty (rubbish, faeces or animals)
items.fix: Clean the area and agree a cleaning rota

items.q: The supply pipe is exposed near the tap
items.fix: Bury or sleeve the exposed pipe

items.q: A pipe leak is visible within 10 m of the tap
items.fix: Repair the leak

items.q: Supply was interrupted in the last 10 days
items.fix: Check supply hours and pressure for this zone

items.q: Hoses or containers touch the tap outlet
items.fix: Fit a raised outlet and brief the attendant

items.q: No free chlorine was detected at this tap
items.fix: Check the dosing and test again

items.q: The inspection hatch is open, missing or cannot be locked
items.fix: Fit a lockable, overlapping cover

items.q: The roof is cracked or leaks
items.fix: Repair and seal the roof

items.q: Vents or overflow pipes have no insect screen
items.fix: Fit screens to vents and overflows

items.q: Dirt, sediment or animals are visible inside the tank
items.fix: Clean and disinfect the tank

items.q: The tank has not been cleaned in the last 12 months
items.fix: Schedule cleaning and disinfection

items.q: The tank walls leak
items.fix: Repair the leaks

items.q: The tank compound is not fenced or is dirty
items.fix: Fence and clean the compound

items.q: The outlet draws from the very bottom, so sediment enters the supply
items.fix: Raise the outlet or add a scour valve

items.q: The chlorine stock will last less than 14 days
items.fix: Order chlorine now

items.q: Chlorine is stored in sunlight, heat or damp
items.fix: Move the stock to a cool, dry, shaded store

items.q: The doser or dosing pump is not working properly
items.fix: Repair or replace the doser

items.q: There is no working test kit or reagents on site
items.fix: Supply a test kit and reagents

items.q: No dosing record was kept in the last 7 days
items.fix: Restart the daily dosing log

items.q: Contact time before the first user is under 30 minutes
items.fix: Add contact volume or move the dosing point

items.q: The raw water is visibly cloudy
items.fix: Add settling or filtration before chlorination

items.q: The operator has no gloves, goggles or apron
items.fix: Provide protective equipment
